response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, but lacks direct C++ experience in recent roles (last significant C++ work was in 2015 at National Instruments). While his embedded systems and real-time programming background in D and C is relevant, his current stack is heavily JavaScript/TypeScript-focused, and he does not demonstrate expertise in cloud platforms, industrial automation protocols, or IEC 62443 standards required for this role. His strengths in architecture and secure coding practices (e.g., TDD, CI/CD) are partially aligned but not directly transferable to C++ industrial automation solutions.
strengths: Strong background in low-latency, real-time systems (D, C)
Proven expertise in secure development practices (TDD, CI/CD, SDL)
Diverse experience in embedded, web, and distributed systems
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last significant role in 2015)
No demonstrated exposure to industrial automation protocols (Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC UA)
Lacks cloud platform experience (Azure) and industrial cybersecurity knowledge (IEC 62443)
